datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Chad administrative units. Geographic data was compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) with classification scales, scenarios, and assistance requirements for near-term food insecurity projections in 2019.
